### Install
1. Download the `.dmg` below, open it and drag **Sightline** to Applications.
2. The app isn't notarized yet, so macOS blocks the first launch. Allow it once via
   **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**, or run:
   ```
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Sightline.app
   ```

Requires macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later. Universal build (Apple Silicon + Intel).
